_style: cartoon dungeon foley, crisp close-mic, punchy, no music, no voices

stamp.prompt: heavy rubber stamp slamming onto a wooden desk, single thump

pop.prompt: bright cartoon bubble pop, single short pop

sparkle.prompt: magical twinkle sparkle chime, short and bright

clank.prompt: single heavy iron latch clank, metal trap part locking into place

whoosh.prompt: fast cartoon swoosh of a body falling through the air

whoosh_big.prompt: deep heavy whoosh of a large stone slab swinging into place

spike.prompt: body landing on a bed of iron spikes at the bottom of a pit, sharp metal stab and crunch

thud.prompt: boots landing on a stone floor, soft heavy cartoon thud

chain.prompt: heavy iron chain rattling and unspooling through a pulley

click.prompt: pressure plate click, stone tile sinking with a sharp mechanical click

trap_open.prompt: wooden trapdoor dropping open on iron hinges, creak and bang

trap_close.prompt: wooden trapdoor slamming shut on iron hinges, solid wooden bang

ice.prompt: ice spell freezing, crackling frost spreading and crystallising with a glassy chime

ignite.prompt: flamethrower nozzle igniting, gas whoomp burst of fire

fire_loop.prompt: steady roaring jet of fire from alchemical flamethrowers, continuous loop

sizzle.prompt: hot sizzle and steam hiss as a mage is scorched by flames

ratchet.prompt: heavy wooden ratchet being cranked slowly, giant pendulum blade cocked back, steady clicks

clang.prompt: giant pendulum blade hitting a steel shield, loud ringing metal clang

rumble.prompt: deep stone rumble, hidden chamber walls grinding open, earthquake

dust.prompt: stone dust and pebbles falling and settling after a wall opens

growl.prompt: hungry treasure chest monster growling, low wooden creaky snarl

launch.prompt: wooden catapult arm firing, big creaky thwack launching a knight into the air

chomp.prompt: giant monster chest chomping shut, wooden jaws slam with a gulp

chew.prompt: cartoon monster chewing armour noisily, metal crunching in wooden jaws

helmet.prompt: empty steel helmet bouncing and clattering on a stone floor

twang.prompt: taut rope plucked, short springy twang

boom.prompt: magical explosion boom, deep punchy blast
